inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detect privilege escalation to Global Admin role via compromised service principal

properties.description: The below Sentinel KQL analytics rule is able to detect potential privilege escalation to Global Admin role via compromised service principal
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detect privilege escalation to Global Admin role via compromised service principal
properties.query:
let GA = dynamic(['GA1@acme.com', 'GA2@acme.com', 'GA3@acme.com']);
AuditLogs 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Category == "RoleManagement"
| where ActivityDisplayName == "Add member to role"
| where TargetResources contains "Global Administrator"
| extend UPN = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where not (UPN has_any(GA))
